hyperedges.label: SDLC MCP Core Architecture: Routing, Memory, Orchestration
hyperedges.rationale: These six components form the core architecture of the SDLC MCP server as described across FEATURE_DETAILS.md and PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md. The routing engine uses the agent registry and LLM integration to select agents, memory systems persist knowledge, workflow templates define orchestration patterns, and MCP tools expose all capabilities to IDEs.

hyperedges.label: IBKR Repository Maturity Journey: Audit to Level 3 Production-Ready
hyperedges.rationale: The repository audit (REPOSITORY_AUDIT_SUMMARY.md) established Level 2 foundations, then the Level 3 achievement (LEVEL3_ACHIEVEMENT.md) elevated the project to production-ready status. AGENTS.md provides operational guidance and README.md documents the complete system - all four files chronicle the progressive maturation of the IBKR Algo Trader codebase.

hyperedges.label: SDLC Agent Import Strategy: Existing Systems to MCP Integration
hyperedges.rationale: The audit report (SDLC_AGENT_AUDIT_REPORT.md) identified that 800 KB of production-ready infrastructure already exists in the SDLC agent directory, including orchestration engines (246 KB), workflow systems (300 KB), test framework (64 KB), and observability (51 KB). The import strategy advocates reusing these rather than rebuilding, forming a coherent reuse pipeline from existing code into the MCP server.

hyperedges.description: The Phase 15.5 Fundamental Analysis System encompasses ratio calculators, quality scorers, and composite scoring working together as an integrated pipeline for institutional-grade stock analysis

The critical path for production trading requires IBKR connectivity, event bus for inter-component communication, order state machine for order lifecycle management, and circuit breakers for fault tolerance
The polyglot persistence strategy uses PostgreSQL for ACID transactions, ClickHouse for time-series analytics, and Neo4j for knowledge graphs, each optimized for its data access patterns

hyperedges.label: SDLC MCP Core Architecture: Routing, Memory, Orchestration
hyperedges.rationale: These six components form the core architecture of the SDLC MCP server as described across FEATURE_DETAILS.md and PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md. The routing engine uses the agent registry and LLM integration to select agents, memory systems persist knowledge, workflow templates define orchestration patterns, and MCP tools expose all capabilities to IDEs.

hyperedges.label: IBKR Repository Maturity Journey: Audit to Level 3 Production-Ready
hyperedges.rationale: The repository audit (REPOSITORY_AUDIT_SUMMARY.md) established Level 2 foundations, then the Level 3 achievement (LEVEL3_ACHIEVEMENT.md) elevated the project to production-ready status. AGENTS.md provides operational guidance and README.md documents the complete system - all four files chronicle the progressive maturation of the IBKR Algo Trader codebase.

hyperedges.label: SDLC Agent Import Strategy: Existing Systems to MCP Integration
hyperedges.rationale: The audit report (SDLC_AGENT_AUDIT_REPORT.md) identified that 800 KB of production-ready infrastructure already exists in the SDLC agent directory, including orchestration engines (246 KB), workflow systems (300 KB), test framework (64 KB), and observability (51 KB). The import strategy advocates reusing these rather than rebuilding, forming a coherent reuse pipeline from existing code into the MCP server.
